description: This file contains the implementation of EventHubAdapterReceiver, a class responsible for managing the reception of messages from an Azure Event Hub partition within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes initialization, message retrieval, cache management, and shutdown logic, along with internal classes and methods handling event hub receiver creation, cursor management, and logging.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionSettings
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for an Event Hub partition, including the hub options, receiver options, and partition name.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Manages receiving messages from an Event Hub partition, including initializing connection, fetching messages, and managing cache and state.

classes.name: StreamActivityNotificationBatch
classes.description: Represents a batch container that signals activity on a stream, used internally for notification.

classes.name: Cursor
classes.description: Implements IQueueCacheCursor for iterating over cached messages in the EventHub queue.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver, setting up the checkpointer, cache, and actual EventHub receiver.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Fetches messages from the Event Hub receiver up to a specified maximum count.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Placeholder method; actual cache addition is handled directly.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge the cache based on pressure conditions.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor for iterating over cached messages for a given stream and token.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, closing connections and disposing of resources.
